## Overview

Use this page for your Point Transformer v1/v2/v3 notes.

A generic local attention update may be written as

$$
y_i = \sum_{j \in \mathcal{N}(i)} \alpha_{ij} \odot
\left(v_j + \delta(p_i-p_j)\right).
$$

## Topics

- k-nearest-neighbor grouping
- relative positional encoding
- vector attention
- transition down / transition up
- serialized attention
